```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* Respect theme colors and enhance existing styles */
.about-hero {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem 1rem 3rem 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.about-hero h1 {
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--bs-primary), var(--bs-info, #0dcaf0));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.intro-paragraph {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  background: var(--bs-light, rgba(0,0,0,0.03));
  border-radius: 10px;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--bs-primary);
}

.journey-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  margin: 3rem 0;
}

.timeline-container {
  position: relative;
}

.timeline-container::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 1rem;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, 
    var(--bs-primary) 0%,
    var(--bs-info, #0dcaf0) 50%,
    var(--bs-success, #198754) 100%);
  border-radius: 1px;
}

.journey-step {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 3rem 3rem;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, white);
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #dee2e6);
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: all 0.4s ease;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.journey-step::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -2.5rem;
  top: 1.5rem;
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  background: var(--bs-secondary, #6c757d);
  border: 3px solid var(--bs-body-bg, white);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.journey-step.active {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(10px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  border-color: var(--bs-primary);
}

.journey-step.active::before {
  background: var(--bs-primary);
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  left: -2.7rem;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb, 13,110,253), 0.2);
}

.step-period {
  color: var(--bs-secondary, #6c757d);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.step-title {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

.step-company {
  color: var(--bs-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.step-location {
  color: var(--bs-secondary, #6c757d);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  font-style: italic;
}

.step-content {
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.project-highlight {
  background: var(--bs-light, rgba(0,0,0,0.03));
  padding: 1rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--bs-info, #0dcaf0);
}

.project-highlight h4 {
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.project-highlight ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1rem;
}

.project-highlight li {
  margin: 0.2rem 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

.skill-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.skill-tag {
  background: var(--bs-primary);
  color: white;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 15px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.map-sticky {
  position: sticky;
  top: 2rem;
  height: 75vh;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, white);
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #dee2e6);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

.journey-progress {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 0%;
  height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bs-primary), var(--bs-info, #0dcaf0));
  transition: width 0.3s ease;
  z-index: 1000;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .journey-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
  }
  
  .map-sticky {
    position: relative;
    height: 50vh;
    order: -1;
  }
  
  .journey-step {
    margin: 0 0 2rem 2rem;
  }
  
  .timeline-container::before {
    left: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .journey-step::before {
    left: -1.5rem;
  }
  
  .journey-step.active::before {
    left: -1.7rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .about-hero h1 {
    background: linear-gradient(45deg, #6366f1, #06b6d4);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
  }
}

/* Custom scrollbar for webkit browsers */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: var(--bs-light, #f8f9fa);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--bs-secondary, #6c757d);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--bs-primary);
}
```

```{js, echo=FALSE}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Progress bar
  const progressBar = document.createElement('div');
  progressBar.className = 'journey-progress';
  document.body.appendChild(progressBar);
  
  // Update progress on scroll
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    const scrollTop = document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    const scrollHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - document.documentElement.clientHeight;
    const progress = (scrollTop / scrollHeight) * 100;
    progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
  });
  
  // Intersection Observer for timeline
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        // Remove active class from all steps
        document.querySelectorAll('.journey-step').forEach(step => {
          step.classList.remove('active');
        });
        
        // Add active class to current step
        entry.target.classList.add('active');
        
        // Update map
        if (typeof window.updateJourneyMap === 'function') {
          window.updateJourneyMap(entry.target.id);
        }
      }
    });
  }, {
    threshold: 0.5,
    rootMargin: '-20% 0px -60% 0px'
  });

  // Observe all journey steps
  document.querySelectorAll('.journey-step').forEach(step => {
    observer.observe(step);
  });
});
```

# About Me

::: {.intro-paragraph}
I am an aspiring Associate Transportation Planner with a Master's in City & Metropolitan Planning and a background in architecture, specializing in data-driven, multimodal strategies that advance equity, sustainability, and community well-being. I have over three years of hands-on experience in multimodal system evaluation, GIS modeling, benefit-cost and economic impact analysis for state and regional projects. I am skilled in leading interagency programs, managing complex contracts, and engaging diverse stakeholders to deliver innovative, resilient, and accessible transportation solutions grounded in inclusive, community-driven planning.
:::
:::

```{r journey_map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Create the map
journey_map <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  setView(lng = 20, lat = 35, zoom = 2)

# Add comprehensive JavaScript for map functionality
journey_map <- onRender(journey_map, "
function(el, x) {
  // Store map reference globally
  window.journeyMap = this;
  
  // Disable user interactions for cleaner experience
  this.dragging.disable();
  this.touchZoom.disable();
  this.doubleClickZoom.disable();
  this.scrollWheelZoom.disable();
  this.boxZoom.disable();
  this.keyboard.disable();
  if (this.tap) this.tap.disable();
  
  // Define location coordinates and zoom levels
  window.mapLocations = {
    kathmandu: {
      lng: 85.3240, 
      lat: 27.7172, 
      zoom: 6,
      name: 'Kathmandu, Nepal'
    },
    saltlake: {
      lng: -111.8910, 
      lat: 40.7608, 
      zoom: 6,
      name: 'Salt Lake City, Utah'
    },
    atlanta: {
      lng: -84.3880, 
      lat: 33.7490, 
      zoom: 6,
      name: 'Atlanta, Georgia'
    },
    overview: {
      lng: 20, 
      lat: 35, 
      zoom: 2,
      name: 'Global Overview'
    }
  };
  
  // Arrays to track map elements
  window.currentMarkers = [];
  window.currentLines = [];
  
  // Enhanced marker creation function
  var createLocationMarker = function(location, popup, isPrimary) {
    var size = isPrimary ? 16 : 12;
    var color = isPrimary ? '#0d6efd' : '#6c757d';
    var pulseEffect = isPrimary ? 'animation: marker-pulse 2s infinite;' : '';
    
    var markerHtml = '<div style=\"' +
      'background: ' + color + ';' +
      'width: ' + size + 'px;' +
      'height: ' + size + 'px;' +
      'border-radius: 50%;' +
      'border: 3px solid white;' +
      'box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);' +
      pulseEffect +
      '\"></div>' +
      '<style>' +
      '@keyframes marker-pulse {' +
        '0% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }' +
        '50% { transform: scale(1.15); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(13,110,253,0.4); }' +
        '100% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }' +
      '}' +
      '</style>';
    
    var icon = L.divIcon({
      html: markerHtml,
      iconSize: [size, size],
      className: 'custom-journey-marker'
    });
    
    var marker = L.marker([location.lat, location.lng], {icon: icon});
    
    if (popup) {
      marker.bindPopup(popup, {
        className: 'custom-journey-popup',
        maxWidth: 280,
        closeButton: false
      });
    }
    
    window.currentMarkers.push(marker);
    return marker;
  };
  
  // Function to create journey path lines
  var createJourneyLine = function(locations, style) {
    var coordinates = locations.map(function(loc) {
      return [loc.lat, loc.lng];
    });
    
    var lineStyle = {
      color: style.color || '#6c757d',
      weight: style.weight || 3,
      opacity: style.opacity || 0.7,
      dashArray: style.dashArray || null,
      className: 'journey-path-line'
    };
    
    var line = L.polyline(coordinates, lineStyle);
    window.currentLines.push(line);
    return line;
  };
  
  // Clear all map elements
  var clearAllMapElements = function() {
    window.currentMarkers.forEach(function(marker) {
      window.journeyMap.removeLayer(marker);
    });
    window.currentLines.forEach(function(line) {
      window.journeyMap.removeLayer(line);
    });
    window.currentMarkers = [];
    window.currentLines = [];
  };
  
  // Smooth map transition function
  var transitionToLocation = function(location) {
    window.journeyMap.flyTo(
      [location.lat, location.lng], 
      location.zoom, 
      {
        animate: true,
        duration: 2.0,
        easeLinearity: 0.15
      }
    );
  };
  
  // Main map update function - this is called from the scroll observer
  window.updateJourneyMap = function(stepId) {
    console.log('updateJourneyMap called with:', stepId);
    
    if (!window.journeyMap) {
      console.log('Map not ready yet');
      return;
    }
    
    // Clear existing elements
    clearAllMapElements();
    console.log('Map elements cleared');
    
    // Add delay to ensure smooth transition
    setTimeout(function() {
      console.log('Processing step:', stepId);
      
      switch(stepId) {
        case 'step-current':
          console.log('Showing Atlanta');
          transitionToLocation(window.mapLocations.atlanta);
          setTimeout(function() {
            createLocationMarker(
              window.mapLocations.atlanta,
              '<strong>Atlanta, Georgia</strong><br/>Transportation Analytics<br/>Metro Analytics (2023-Present)',
              true
            ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
          }, 1000);
          break;
          
        case 'step-teaching':
        case 'step-gis':
        case 'step-masters':
          console.log('Showing Salt Lake City');
          transitionToLocation(window.mapLocations.saltlake);
          setTimeout(function() {
            createLocationMarker(
              window.mapLocations.saltlake,
              '<strong>Salt Lake City, Utah</strong><br/>Graduate Studies & Research<br/>University of Utah (2021-2023)',
              true
            ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
            
            // Show connection to current position for masters step
            if (stepId === 'step-masters') {
              createLocationMarker(
                window.mapLocations.atlanta,
                '<strong>Atlanta</strong><br/>Current Position',
                false
              ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
              
              createJourneyLine(
                [window.mapLocations.saltlake, window.mapLocations.atlanta],
                {color: '#0d6efd', weight: 3, opacity: 0.8}
              ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
            }
          }, 1000);
          break;
          
        case 'step-prabal':
        case 'step-rtcsu':
        case 'step-urbanpark':
        case 'step-archetype':
        case 'step-bachelors':
          console.log('Showing Kathmandu');
          transitionToLocation(window.mapLocations.kathmandu);
          setTimeout(function() {
            createLocationMarker(
              window.mapLocations.kathmandu,
              '<strong>Kathmandu, Nepal</strong><br/>Architecture & Urban Planning<br/>(2013-2021)',
              true
            ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
            
            // Show full journey path for professional positions
            if (['step-prabal', 'step-rtcsu', 'step-urbanpark', 'step-archetype'].includes(stepId)) {
              createLocationMarker(
                window.mapLocations.saltlake,
                '<strong>Salt Lake City</strong><br/>Graduate Studies',
                false
              ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
              
              createLocationMarker(
                window.mapLocations.atlanta,
                '<strong>Atlanta</strong><br/>Current Position',
                false
              ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
              
              createJourneyLine(
                [window.mapLocations.kathmandu, window.mapLocations.saltlake, window.mapLocations.atlanta],
                {color: '#6c757d', weight: 2, opacity: 0.6}
              ).addTo(window.journeyMap);
            }
          }, 1000);
          break;
          
        default:
          console.log('Default overview');
          // Default overview
          transitionToLocation(window.mapLocations.overview);
          break;
      }
    }, 200);
  };
  
  // Make function globally available
  window.updateMap = window.updateJourneyMap;
  updateJourneyMap = window.updateJourneyMap;
  
  console.log('updateJourneyMap function created and stored globally');
  
  // Initialize map with first step
  setTimeout(function() {
    console.log('Initializing map with first step');
    window.updateJourneyMap('step-current');
  }, 500);
}
")

journey_map
```

**Planning Expertise:** Multimodal Transportation Planning, Heritage Conservation, Smart City Development, Infrastructure Planning, Project Management, Stakeholder Engagement

**Languages:** English (Full Professional), Nepali (Native), Hindi (Native), Spanish (Elementary)

**Certifications:** Analyzing US Census Data in R, Introduction to ArcGIS API for Python, Joining Data with dplyr, Introduction to Statistics in R
